rationale: The pain is real and financially consequential when it occurs, but evidence is too thin to pass validation: a single StackExchange post, no distinct pain quotes from 5 or more sources, and no direct willingness-to-pay signal specific to a Postmaster Tools setup/monitoring service. Adjacent paid solutions (GlockApps, MxToolbox, Postmark) address deliverability broadly but the specific GPT onboarding gap lacks documented recurring demand. The one-time-fix nature of most GPT issues also undermines recurring revenue potential.
